gui.note: The existing GUI surface does not expose per-operation token or elapsed-time telemetry in this workspace. No values were estimated.

paired_reference_strategy.description: Two representative real-work pairs compared the prior reference-file/tool-reading strategy with focused inline App Server context. This is a strategy comparison, not fabricated GUI telemetry.

quality_review.planning: Focused inline Sol planning was scope-aligned and sufficient for downstream work. The reference strategy was more detailed and surfaced extra possible risks, but was substantially more expensive.
quality_review.verification: Terra was appropriately conservative when evidence was absent and found integration defects that were reproduced and fixed. Manual review also identified context-bound false positives, so verification findings still require evidence-based adjudication.
quality_review.reliability: All 30 core real-campaign turns completed without adapter failure. A live cancellation reconciliation race remains a promotion blocker.
